success.title: Success
success.description: Indicates whether the health check completed successfully.

orderName.title: Order Name
orderName.description: The order name that was checked.

lineItemCount.title: Line Item Count
lineItemCount.description: Total number of line items found in this order.

performingWellCount.title: Performing Well Count
performingWellCount.description: Number of line items classified as Performing Well.

needsAttentionCount.title: Needs Attention Count
needsAttentionCount.description: Number of line items classified as Needs Attention.

lineItemHealthBreakdown.title: Line Item Health Breakdown
lineItemHealthBreakdown.description: JSON array of per-line-item health entries: lineItemId, creative, pacingPercentage, fillRatePercentage, cpm, status (PERFORMING_WELL, NEEDS_ATTENTION, or NOT_EVALUABLE), and suggestion (a plain-language sentence, present only for NEEDS_ATTENTION).

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable summary of the health check results.
